fact.box: Newton (Canadian crypto exchange) BTC withdrawal to your own wallet
fact.claim: Newton gives three speeds for moving bitcoin to your own wallet. Fast costs $10 CAD plus the network fee, Standard costs only the network fee, and Free has no fee but goes out once a night. On your first withdrawal each day, Newton pays up to $5 CAD of the network fee. At Wealthsimple you pay just the network fee the blockchain charges, and the app shows you an estimate before you send.

plain.what: Newton is a Canadian app for buying and selling bitcoin. When you move your bitcoin out of Newton into your own wallet, Newton gives you three speeds. Fast costs $10 CAD plus the network fee, which is what the blockchain itself charges to move the coins. Standard costs only that network fee, and Free costs nothing but only goes out once a night.
plain.so_what: That $10 is easy to miss, but tapping Fast once a month adds up to $120 in a year, and once a week comes to $520, before any network fee.
plain.do: Open your app and write down which speed is already picked for your next bitcoin withdrawal.
